test_type: Bug Batch: BUG-023, BUG-021, BUG-020, BUG-022
summary: All 4 bugs verified as fixed. BUG-023 (₹ icon), BUG-021 (Adjust Stock removed), BUG-020 (store names in transactions), BUG-022 (PO redirect) all working correctly.

features_tested.feature: BUG-023: Production Run Form shows ₹ icon for cost
features_tested.details: Estimated Material Cost shows '₹7.00 (₹1.40/piece)'. IndianRupee icon from lucide-react renders correctly.

features_tested.feature: BUG-023: Production History shows ₹ icon for Unit Cost and Total Cost
features_tested.details: KPI cards show '₹4.9K TOTAL MATERIAL COST', 'Avg ₹2.57/unit'. All runs table shows ₹ symbols (₹2.48, ₹2,607.85, etc.). Expanded detail shows 'Unit Cost: ₹2.48 Total: ₹2.48'.

features_tested.feature: BUG-023: Sub-Recipe Master shows ₹ icon for Material Cost
features_tested.details: Intelligence section shows ₹ symbol for 'Material Cost/batch'. Value shows '—' when no cost data available, but icon is correct.

features_tested.feature: BUG-021: Operations Hub Quick Actions does NOT show 'Adjust Stock' card
features_tested.details: Quick Actions shows: Dispatch Stock, Purchase, Run Production, Record Wastage, Wastage Report. No 'Adjust Stock' card present.

features_tested.feature: BUG-020: Store Detail transactions show real store names
features_tested.details: History & Ledger shows Source/Destination with real names: 'german fluid', 'Cost Test Outlet', 'Central Kitchen Alpha', 'Outlet Direct One'. Transfer Detail shows 'FROM: german fluid Central Store' and 'TO: Cost Test Outlet Outlet'. No 'Unknown: —' found.

features_tested.feature: BUG-022: /purchase auto-redirects to /purchase/orders when PO required
features_tested.details: Navigating to /purchase redirects to /purchase/orders. Purchase Orders page loads with existing POs. Note: /add-stock route doesn't exist (falls through to catch-all redirect to /), but /purchase correctly redirects.

issues: Store type badge shows 'Unknown' for some stores (e.g., Store #806, #807, #809). This is a minor display issue - the store type is not being resolved from the API response.

critical_code_review_comments: BUG-023: IndianRupee icon correctly imported from lucide-react in ProductionRunForm.jsx (line 22), ProductionHistory.jsx (line 11), SubRecipeMaster.jsx (line 13)
BUG-021: canDo('adjust-stock') card block removed from OperationsHub.jsx Quick Actions section
BUG-020: useRestaurantMap hook added to StoreDetail.jsx, restaurantMap lookup used for From/To columns in transactions table
BUG-022: AddStockPurchaseForm.jsx uses <Navigate to='/purchase/orders' replace /> when poRequired is true
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug batch BUG-023, BUG-021, BUG-020, BUG-022 all verified. IndianRupee (₹) icon displays correctly in Production Run Form, Production History, and Sub-Recipe Master. Adjust Stock card removed from Operations Hub Quick Actions. Store Detail transactions show real store names via restaurantMap lookup. /purchase redirects to /purchase/orders when PO is required. Minor note: Store Detail header shows 'Unknown' badge for store type - this is a pre-existing display issue, not related to the current bug fixes.
